1722923.overview: In 2007, a series of recovered recordings documents the final encounters with beings that could still be distinguished from us.

1723435.title: Bow and Apple
1723435.overview: After a scientist crash-lands in a remote jungle, he is found by a solitary runaway hunter who has built her life deep in the forest. Despite their differences, the two form an uneasy alliance when they discover they’re hunted by the same enemy—the brutal president who possesses the mythical Golden Apple, a relic said to hold immense, world-shaping power.

1724267.title: The Bovine Comedy
1724267.overview: In a future where cows have nearly vanished, Phop, a rich farmer, owns Southeast Asia's last bull.

1726059.title: Love Finds You
1726059.overview: A mislabeled package convinces jewelry designer Alex she's found her ideal man, sending her and delivery driver Jack on a citywide search that helps them discover what they truly want.

1726379.title: Kafka
1726379.overview: A young man named Grigor Grigoryan wakes up from a strange slumber and finds that he has transformed into the writer Franz Kafka. He is shocked by profound sorrow and frailty and he desperately feels the need to understand how he must continue living now.

1726699.title: Yellow
1726699.overview: A therapist's patients all report the same terrifying vision: a yellow doppelganger coming to replace them. His search for answers uncovers a dark secret hidden in the past.

1726763.title: Aracne
1726763.overview: Eris is a talented and ambitious young chef who works at the prestigious Medusa restaurant. The restaurant is run by Palas, an experienced chef whose work style clashes with that of our protagonist. Eris enters a culinary duel for Palas’s position, and that’s when a dead spider is discovered on her plate. Eventually, the two open up to each other and reveal their vulnerabilities as they reflect on the price of pursuing their dreams.

1727019.title: Ãsheghetam
1727019.overview: During a chaotic night at an underground Tehran rave disrupted by the morality police and the sudden outbreak of war, a queer youth chooses to retreat into a bubble of romantic illusion with their partner, just to survive the brutal reality outside.

1729323.title: Bhootam Bhayyam
1729323.overview: Seven unemployed friends move into a cursed mansion and discover a mysterious coin. Using it in planchette sessions for quick cash, they awaken ancient forces. Now spirits and occultists hunt them as dark secrets emerge.

1729643.title: The Illusion of an Everlasting Summer
1729643.overview: Filmed over twenty-five years, The Illusion of an Everlasting Summer traces the lives of two inseparable cousins, Guillermina and Belinda, as they grow up in the vast Argentine Pampas.

1731115.title: De bovenburen
1731115.overview: A seemingly ordinary dinner invitation sets the stage for an evening in which boundaries are pushed, secrets are revealed, and relationships are tested in both hilarious and heartwarming ways.

1732587.title: The Chittering
1732587.overview: In an independent movie theater, a small documentary production investigates a conspiracy involving rodents. However, the crew becomes entangled in a web of mystery and darkness as they push the theater staff a little too far.

1733547.title: Misfortune in Life, of a man who suffers in silence
1733547.overview: In a vast empty parking garage that seems to stretch without end, Lennart, an aging bank employee, discovers that he can no longer find his car.  What begins as a minor inconvenience slowly transforms into an absurd journey through identical floors, quiet reflections and strange encounters. As he searches the concrete maze, reality starts to bend around him. A mysterious figure appears and disappears, offering riddles instead of answers, while the outside world waits for his return.  Trapped in a cycle of repetition and frustration, Lennart is forced to confront a growing sense of hopelessness. As the search continues, the missing car becomes more than a lost vehicle. It becomes a reflection of a man struggling to regain his control in a world that seems to move forward without him.  Misfortune in Life, for a Man Who Suffers in Silence is an absurdist drama about hopelessness, loss of control, and the quiet fear of being left behind.

1735403.title: Brindavihari
1735403.overview: Brindhavihari is an upcoming Kannada romantic musical entertainer directed by Srinivas Raju.
1735403.trailerName: BRINDAVIHARI TITLE TEASER| GOLDEN STAR GANESH | SRINIVAS RAJU|HESHAM ABDUL WAHAB

1735723.title: Private Property
1735723.overview: Two outsiders – Maya, a Nepali immigrant working overnight to build a future, and Danny, an unhoused Black veteran searching for warmth and shelter – clash over one small space. Maya reaches for the law, then a gun, to belong.

1736491.title: Tijuana, Todavía
1736491.overview: In Playas de Tijuana, a young queer man fleeing Russia to avoid being conscripted in the Ukraine war due to his identity, and a middle-aged gay man navigating Northern Mexican machismo, connect through a gay hookup app where they hide behind digital alter egos. When their relationship moves offline, they come face to face with the wounds inflicted by their respective exiles.

1739499.title: Alien Spa
1739499.overview: Three siblings, grieving the death of their parents, have a spa day from hell (or shall we say... from space).
1739499.trailerName: Scientists Discover 'Strongest Evidence' of Alien Life So Far - Or Did They?

1739819.title: Jannath
1739819.overview: A high-stakes, deeply emotional courtroom and familial conflict.
1739819.trailerName: JANNATH | TRAILER | SHARAF | KOPEE ISSEY | SHUHA | YAADHA| DARK RAIN ENTERTAINMENT

1740587.title: My Happy Place
1740587.overview: A burned-out office worker discovers a hidden passage to a vibrant bar where he’s effortlessly loved and admired. As this secret escape transforms his confidence and identity, he begins to change in his real life too, forcing him to confront a difficult choice between staying in the fantasy or fully embracing reality.

1741227.title: Let Me In
1741227.overview: Following the death of his partner, a grieving man finds himself haunted by mysterious post-it notes that slowly blur the line between grief, memory, or something far more sinister…

1741419.title: WWE Survivor Series: WarGames 2026
1741419.overview: The 2026 Survivor Series: WarGames, also promoted as Survivor Series: WarGames Houston, is an upcoming professional wrestling pay-per-view and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It will be the 40th annual Survivor Series and will take place on November 28, 2026, at Daikin Park in Houston, Texas. This will be the fifth annual Survivor Series based around the WarGames match, a team-based steel cage match where the roofless cage surrounds two rings placed side by side.
1741419.trailerName: BREAKING: Survivor Series set for Daikin Park in Houston on Saturday, Nov. 28

1744555.title: Field Mouse
1744555.overview: There's a mouse trapped in Leonard's house. It's stuck in the walls of the basement.

1745131.title: Pain
1745131.overview: March 8th, stand-up club. Ira's performance immediately goes awry: her ex is in the audience with his new girlfriend. And an intoxicated audience member decides to interfere with the evening's program. It gradually becomes increasingly difficult to discern where the show ends and real life begins.

1745259.title: Twix
1745259.overview: Close friends decide to make fun of a "rich" schoolboy, taking advantage of his advances, but begin competing for his attention, even to the point of smearing chocolate on his face.

1746475.title: Perception
1746475.overview: A troubled young man is pushed to his limits as he tries to find the man responsible for his girlfriend's recent disappearance. In his mission for answers, he speaks with his therapist who guides him to a horrifying discovery which changes his perception forever.

1747627.title: On The Edge
1747627.overview: The main character of our film is Ilyas Sharbuzov, an intensivist from Dagestan, and his family. Ilyas is a perfectionist, and if an emergency occurs, he always tries to be at the epicenter to help. Ilyas's wife, Aminat, worked in the intensive care unit, so she tries to be understanding of her husband's work. His young daughters have also become accustomed to their father's work schedule. But everything changes for Ilyas and his family when he is sent on a mission to a military hospital in a war zone.

1748523.title: Eclipse Memorial
1748523.overview: a Myanmar woman confronts an elderly Thai woman, as personal memories become intertwined with the weight of collective history.

1749035.title: The Complete Story of Pep Guardiola's Manchester City
1749035.overview: Ten seasons, 20 trophies, fantastic goals, drama, emotion and everything else in-between, sit back and enjoy the journey all over again.

1749291.title: Sin Eater
1749291.overview: After years spent filtering the internet's darkest material, a content moderator spirals into psychological disintegration as the horrors they absorb begin infecting their reality.

1749739.title: Phantom 814
1749739.overview: Heavy Weekend 03: Unique access to the most mysterious organisation in France. Jake Hanrahan travels with the bizarre syndicate known as "814SSR". They shoot guns, host fight clubs, and make money in the underground. Yet still, they insist they're not a gang and are simply doing hardcore trolling. The truth? Decide for yourself...

1750251.title: Men in the Forest
1750251.overview: Two friends are spending the night in the forest. During the night, one of them wakes up and witnesses something he will never forget.

1753195.title: Bid16
1753195.overview: A woman urgently requires access to her storage unit, but her account has gone delinquent and she cannot afford the penalty fees.

1753579.title: Bone Singer
1753579.overview: Kaia, a struggling artist, has been making things happen that she can't explain. Sadie, a young witch, must carry out a cruel ritual, or risk her coven's death. As Kaia and Sadie's fates become increasingly intertwined, the two will go down a path that will irreversibly alter both of their lives.

1754411.title: Gladiator Baby
1754411.overview: A young girl and a young boy must fight for their goals to pave the way for their dreams — but only one of them can get closer to their destination, and only if they are willing to destroy the other’s dream in the gamble of ambition.
1754411.trailerName: GLADIATOR BABY (TRAILER) DIRECTED BY ALI SABOKBAR & ERFAN HOSSEINI (IRAN)

1757035.title: Jenna & Salvador
1757035.overview: Girl meets boy. Boy wins Eurovision. Boy has a heart transplant. A musical documentary.

1760619.title: Rebellion
1760619.overview: In 1981, 12 young Asian men stood trial on terrorism charges for defending Bradford from an imminent racist attack. Their fight for their city – and their freedom – became international news, awakening public consciousness to the rise of fascism and the far-right.

1761067.title: Melody of the Damned
1761067.overview: Two siblings accidentally summon a group of musical demons who take over their late grandmother's attic to put on a variety show.

1764587.title: Mom Died
1764587.overview: Eight siblings just found out that their granddad died. A broken game of telephone happens, and then they all fight.

1769195.title: Pegasus
1769195.overview: A DJ drifts through the spectacle of Miami nightlife, torn between the urge to create and the desire to be seen.

1773035.title: Snow Globe Town
1773035.overview: Emily Church joins her sister Zoe and Zoe’s longtime boyfriend on a Christmas getaway to Pine Grove, a town famous for its romantic holiday traditions. While helping with Zoe’s proposal plans, Emily is paired with skeptical journalist Bert Baxter. As they are drawn into the town’s festive celebrations, unexpected feelings begin to challenge what they both thought they knew about love, family and Christmas.
